dedupe_keys.name: nasa surface operations simulator and scheduler soss fast time simulation of aircraft movement on the airport surface for runway scheduling research

description: SOSS is a NASA Ames fast-time simulation of air traffic movement on an airport surface, listed in the NASA Software Catalog (case ARC-16808-1A, version 2.0 of May 2015). Contents: models of aircraft taxiing between gates and runways on an airport's taxiway network, departure and arrival runway operations and the interaction of surface traffic, with interfaces for plugging in runway schedulers and conflict resolution algorithms so that they can be developed, analysed and tested; it was built because airports are a bottleneck of the National Airspace System and surface automation for control towers was being developed for NextGen. Producer: NASA Ames. Coverage: configurable for individual airports. Format and access: released only for U.S. Government purposes; others cannot obtain it through the catalogue. Licence: NASA U.S. Government Purpose Release. Caveats: not available to the public or foreign users, and airport layouts and traffic must be supplied. Simulation uses: airport surface capacity and delay studies, testing departure scheduling and runway configuration changes, and disruption scenarios such as runway closures. Related records: NASA ACES (model-nasa-aces-airspace-concepts-evaluation-system) simulates airspace operations beyond the airport surface.
